claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Glycopyrrolate is a poorly cell-permeable, peripherally restricted quaternary muscarinic antagonist that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any apparent effect would be weak and non-selective rather than a genuine cytotoxic mechanism.
